project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 3 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 0 of 15 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Not a tourist town

townGuide.headline: A practical local guide to West Felton
townGuide.intro: West Felton has a modest visitor offer within its active settlement boundary. The guide records defensible heritage and practical stops without presenting the place as a destination.
